context: Aoi gives Sho-young a sunflower from her garden.
purpose: Adult and child sharing simple nature gift.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Soft emphasis on the discovery, as if sharing something precious. Slight lift in pitch on the final syllable, drawing him in gently. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うわ、芝生に、ようけ咲いてる!
lines.en: Wow — there are so many blooming on the lawn!
lines.style: Genuine awe, mouth slightly open on the opening word. Bright and energized but not loud. Quick breath between phrases. Real wonder, not performed. Eyes widening in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: テラスから、見るの、好きなの。
lines.en: I love watching them from the terrace.
lines.style: Soft, almost private. Speaking more to herself than to him, but letting him listen. Content, settled tone. Slight nostalgic pull on the middle of the sentence. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 神さま、ありがとう、感じる。
lines.en: God, thank you — I can feel it.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Whisper-soft without being inaudible. Small, genuine voice. Not performing spirituality but feeling it. Slight pause after the gratitude, letting it sit. Exhale on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 果実みたい、種を埋めるとね。
lines.en: Like fruit — when you bury the seed, it becomes something alive.
lines.style: Gentle teaching tone, not lecturing. Thoughtful pace, letting each image breathe. Warm curiosity underneath — she's noticing him, not instructing at him. Slight wonder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 笑みが、自然と出る、こんな所で!
lines.en: A smile just comes naturally in a place like this.
lines.style: Bright, genuine discovery. Slight surprise at his own realization. Quick, alive energy but grounded. Not bouncing — observant. Small laugh hiding underneath the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 振る舞い、大切にしてね、優しさ。
lines.en: Hold onto that — the kindness in moments like these.
lines.style: Gentle instruction without weight. Soft, almost singing in the delivery. Speaking from something true in her. Slight trailing-off, like a wish rather than a command. Warm, maternal undertone.
